newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DCB Holdings raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DCB Holdings raised.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities said on Friday it had upgraded its rating for Malaysian financial company DCB Holdings Bhd to long-term buy from market performer.
-- "Restructuring enhances DCB Holdings' competitive position," analyst John Wadle wrote in a report.

-- The upgrade came because of "DCB's stronger revenue generating power, its improved scope to keep its cost-to-income ratio at the lowest in the industry and the greater capacity it should now have to expand its customer banking business."
-- Wadle set a price target of M$9.5 to M$10 for the next 12 to 18 months.
